title: Find a household chemical cleanout event
summary: Find out about free household chemical cleanout events hosted by the NSW Government and local councils.
intro:
You can dispose of hazardous household chemicals at household chemical cleanout events.

The NSW Government works together with local councils to host these events, which are free and held across NSW on specified dates throughout the year.

You can drop off up to 20 litres or 20 kilograms of a single item for the following chemicals at cleanout events:
what_you_need: Up to 20 litres or 20 kilograms of a single item for the following chemicals.
